name: society-mgmt-300k
description: Society management synthetic benchmark (~300,000 LOC of dependency-free vanilla JavaScript). Source is delivered in society_mgmt_300k.zip and extracted to src/ and tests/ via `npm run unpack`.

scripts.build: find src tests -name '*.js' -print0 | xargs -0 -n1 node --check && echo 'syntax-check: OK'
